articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Why real-world assets need fixed-rate loans onchain
articles.snippet: Real-world assets already back the largest stablecoins, yet borrowing against them onchain still runs through variable-rate pools. Peter Gaffney of O2O Capital Partners explains why fixed-rate, fixed-term lending is the missing piece, and how a 5% shift in Sky and Ethena reserves could create $1.8 billion of demand for real-world assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.snippet: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

articles.title: Bitcoin corrects below $82K after Tesla Q3 results, KOSPI falls
articles.snippet: Bitcoin reversed a run toward $85,000 after Tesla reported lower-than-expected capital expenditure in Q3.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation urges EU against expanding MiCA rules to DeFi and staking
articles.snippet: The foundation called for regulation based on financial risks rather than technology, warning that overlapping rules could create uncertainty for crypto businesses across the EU.

articles.title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
articles.snippet: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's 60.6% vote.
